changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE modeling_model_access ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id varchar(128) NOT NULL, model_spec_id uuid NOT NULL, grantee_type varchar(8) NOT NULL CHECK(grantee_type IN ('USER','ROLE')), grantee_id varchar(128) NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(grantee_id) <> ''), grantee_name varchar(256), permission varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK(permission = 'EDITOR'), granted_by varchar(128) NOT NULL, granted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_by varchar(128), revoked_at timestamptz, CONSTRAINT fk_modeling_access_model FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, model_spec_id) REFERENCES modeling_model_spec(tenant_id,id), CONSTRAINT ck_modeling_access_revoke CHECK((revoked_by IS NULL) = (revoked_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_modeling_access_role CHECK(grantee_type <> 'ROLE' OR grantee_id IN ('ROLE_DEPT_DATA_OWNER','ROLE_DEPT_LEADER')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_modeling_access_active ON modeling_model_access(tenant_id,model_spec_id,grantee_type,grantee_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL; CREATE INDEX ix_modeling_access_grantee ON modeling_model_access(tenant_id,grantee_type,grantee_id,model_spec_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL; CREATE INDEX ix_modeling_plan_department ON modeling_warehouse_plan(tenant_id,owner_department_id,id);

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 /* Security expansion is retained on binary rollback; disable modeling until compatible code is restored. */
